title: [Dana R, dev branch] Prime/fill not available when pump disconnected
symptom: After disconnecting the pump, the 'prime/fill' button is not available in the actions screen. Previously it was available. The user needs a workaround of switching to open loop, setting basal to 0%, and then priming.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. It appears to be a design change or intentional restriction, but no specific cause is confirmed.
fix: The thread does not provide a clear fix. A workaround is mentioned: switching to open loop, setting basal to 0%, and then priming. Another workaround is doing a bolus through AAPS and then deleting it from treatments.
evidence_quote: Previously, after "disconnect pump", in the actions screen the "prime/fill" button was available. Currently they are not, and I need to use a workaround of switching to "open loop", setting basal to 0%, and then priming.
